subtitle: Moving what you built in a sandbox into production

caption: Before any change set moves, the two orgs authorize each other: Allow Inbound Changes on the receiving side, Accept Outbound Changes on the sending side.
An Outbound Change Set starts as just a Name and Description — the components come next.
Add fields, flows, page layouts, and more — View/Add Dependencies catches what you'd otherwise forget.
On the inbound side, deploying asks which Apex tests to run — Default, Run Local Tests, Run All Tests, or a specified list.
